Perfect! **Bxf7+ Rxf7 Qxa3** wins the Black queen outright, resulting in White being up approximately **+7 material** (queen for bishop). The Black queen is undefended and lost immediately.

**Best move:** Bxf7+

**Main line:** Bxf7+ Rxf7 Qxa3 (winning the undefended queen)

**Motif:** Deflection (the check forces the rook to capture, abandoning defense of the queen)

**Coaching Note:**
Black's queen on a3 hangs undefended. When your opponent's piece lacks protection, look for forcing moves—checks or captures—that exploit that weakness. Here, Bxf7+ forces Black's rook to recapture (it's the only way to stop check), leaving the queen to be captured next move. Always scan for undefended pieces before playing your move; if you spot one on the opponent's side, forcing moves usually win it.
